newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber mixed on Tokyo softness.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber mixed on Tokyo softness.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were mixed at midday due to softness in Tokyo futures, traders said.
They said activity was restrained in the absence of leads and buying interest.
"Everyone's sitting tight, not doing anything," said a trader.
At midday, June RSS 1 buyer was officially quoted at 278.50 cents ($1.11) a kg, down half cent from Monday's close. June SMR 20 buyer was unchanged at an official 263.50 cents.
Traders quoted the SMR20 at 261, SMR CV at 332, SMR 5 at 272, SMR L at 307, SMR 10 at 262.50 and drum latex at 227.
They said region-wide, Malaysian rubber was still at an attractive price, but consumer interest was absent with most US and European buyers having covered their positions until September.
